stories.title: Downtown Knoxville shops gear up for Small Business Saturday
stories.summary: Small businesses in downtown Knoxville are hoping holiday shoppers will choose to shop locally this weekend.

stories.title: DOJ: Knox County man sentenced to over 12 years for distribution of child porn
stories.summary: Federal investigators said 30-year-old Aaron Patrick Odell was distributing child porn on the KiK messaging app.

stories.title: Roane County man sentenced to 10 years for sex trafficking of a child, DOJ says
stories.summary: 59-year-old Jack David Ledford of Rockwood coerced a 15-year-old "to receive illicit sexual acts in exchange for money or gifts."

stories.title: Effects the 2016 wildfires had on wildlife in the Smokies
stories.summary: A decade after the historic 2016 Sevier County wildfires, notable ecological shifts remain in the Smoky Mountains.

stories.title: Caryville woman faces new vehicular homicide charges in Nov. 14 crash that killed 2
stories.summary: Victoria Brock was driving a Nissan Pathfinder that plowed into a vehicle driven by Glen Lowery, 63, on Cecil Avenue. He and Starr Lowery died as a result.

stories.title: A look at the history behind Knoxville's first powwow 4 decades ago
stories.summary: As Indigenous groups gear up for their next powwow in East Tennessee, we want to look at Knoxville's first powwow, held in 1988.

stories.title: Dobyns-Bennett High School secures fundraising so they can stay to perform in postponed Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: This year's 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed for the first time in history due to weather conditions brought by a nor'easter.

stories.title: Home Alone-themed ice exhibit opens at Gaylord Opryland annual Christmas event
stories.summary: Artisans from China traveled to Nashville to carve 6,000 blocks of ice into 11 scenes from the holiday classic 'Home Alone.'

stories.title: Federal hemp law could pull THC drinks from Knoxville shelves
stories.summary: Some THC drinks have already sold out at Knoxville’s Total Wine. Now shoppers are calling Congress to keep their favorites on the shelves after Dec. 11.

stories.title: Knox County family spends Thanksgiving delivering meals to homebound seniors
stories.summary: More than 100 Mobile Meals volunteers delivered Thanksgiving meals to about 600 homebound seniors in Knox County. For one family, it's become a holiday tradition.

stories.title: Tennessee leaders prepare budget recommendations as Gov.-elect Marsha Blackburn plans first priorities
stories.summary: State leaders are meeting throughout this month to start the process of developing Tennessee's budget. A look at the numbers provides details about their priorities.

stories.title: Clinton church donates 1,500 Thanksgiving meals, many to first responders
stories.summary: Second Baptist Church in Clinton united over 200 volunteers to distribute 1,500 Thanksgiving meals, supporting both the less fortunate and local first responders.
